source.notes: The strings are museum catalogue dates (largely Japanese print collections). The source knows only start and end years and a circa flag, so expectations are coarse (years) and reflect yearrange's own conventions, e.g. 'late' = the last quarter of a century, 'mid' = the middle fifth, and 'circa' does not widen (the catalogue-quarters profile). yearrange's circa flag also covered 'probably' and '?', which we flag Uncertain, so the Approximate flag is expected only where the text has circa wording (2026-10-14). Where an original and a later edition are both dated, we date the object by the edition (owner's decision, 2026-10-14) while yearrange is inconsistent, so those entries fail by design. Other differences should be reviewed, not copied.
